verdict.rationale: Appwrite has a public GitHub repository (github.com/appwrite/appwrite), and community members describe it as open source, for example as an 'open-source alternative to Vercel'. Its self-hosting docs fit a source-available product, but no first-party evidence names the license. Missing for 10: first-party statement of the open-source license (e.g. BSD/MIT), explicit documentation that the full server source is published under it, hands-on confirmation of reading or building from source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: the product itself looks worthwhile as an open-source alternative to Vercel
